name: STREAM_ABI_SCOPED_PRESERVATION_POLICY_REFERENCE_V1

sourceJoins: Snapshot dependencies832 bytes; checkpoint448 bytes; covered output manifest608 bytes; output1152 bytes; scoped root Binding800 bytes. Every typed object uses its new profile and exact tuple, with full original scope/factory/policy joins.
